title: Where do these branches go?
hook: A family tree can hold animals with different appearances.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The highlighted branch splits toward both Stegosaurus and Triceratops. They are placed in Ornithischia, on different branches. The simplified tree does not show every dinosaur relationship.

misconception: Animals with very different appearances cannot share a dinosaur subgroup.
objective: In this simplified family tree, are Stegosaurus and Triceratops both within Ornithischia?
